questions.question: How should the StoreTree.dfy ↔ spec 051 alignment (BK-435's Dafny part) be split between the two sessions?

options.label: Comment + we do the tie (Recommended)
options.description: One review comment on #1130 covering only what changes the RFC before acceptance: Key = seq<string> admits empty or '/'-containing segments (TREE-007/011), and A.1's 'sequence of names' vs TREE-009's joined string. This session then adds the @spec TREE-n tags and a ValidName/L6 bridge in #1131 through the usual side PR. #1130's author has little to do. Risk: a rebase if #1130 edits StoreTree.dfy again.

options.label: Handover branch for #1130
options.description: Push a throwaway branch off bk-432-key-resolution with the Dafny change already verified (no TREE tags, since spec 051 isn't on that branch), plus a handover note in ../sandbox/. #1130's author cherry-picks it. #1130 grows and its review starts again on the Dafny file.

options.label: Comments only
options.description: Post inline comments on #1130 at StoreTree.dfy's Key type and at RFC A.1, and leave the fix to #1130's author. Least work here, but the fix happens in a session with no spec 051 context.

options.label: Wait for #1130 to merge
options.description: Do nothing now. The tie happens in BK-435 after #1130 lands, as the backlog already plans. No coordination needed, but any RFC wording issue is found only after acceptance.

options.description: One pending review with two inline comments, at `type Key = seq<string>` in StoreTree.dfy and at RFC-0021 A.1, each with the proposed fix. They become threads the author resolves through /fix-pr.

options.label: One PR-level comment
options.description: A single issue comment that summarizes both points and links spec 051 on #1131. Easier to write, but /fix-pr has no threads to resolve.

questions.question: The #1130 review comments contradict research § 10's recorded decisions (Key fix = BK-434, A.1 lands as accepted). What should happen to them?

options.label: Reply on both threads (Recommended)
options.description: Post one reply on each inline thread: the Key fix is BK-434's per research § 10 and the A.1 pointer is BK-435's after BK-432, so #1130 should change nothing and resolve the threads. The record stays visible and #1130's author does no stray work.

options.label: Delete both comments
options.description: Remove the review comments entirely. Cleaner PR, but the author may already have seen them and there is no record of why they disappeared.

options.label: Leave them, co-ship in #1130
options.description: Overrule the 2026-10-13 decision: let #1130 take the Key type (and the A.1 sentence). BK-434 loses that line. Needs research § 10 and BK-434's entry updated to match.

questions.question: Scope for this BK-435 side PR (into store-model-axioms)?

options.label: Tags + mapping lemma (Recommended)
options.description: Add `// @spec TREE-002/003/012` to ValidTree and `TREE-008/010` on the map representation. Add a small Dafny lemma that a ValidTree's key set is prefix-closed with items only at its leaves (the L6 pair), so the tie is checked rather than only asserted. TREE-007/011 stay with BK-434's Name type, and the A.1 pointer stays for after BK-432. Avoids StoreTree.dfy line 46.

options.label: Tags only
options.description: Comment tags plus a header note mapping §1 to spec 051 and L6, with no new lemma. Smallest diff, but the tie is citation, not proof (ID-207's complaint).

options.label: Also take BK-434's Name type
options.description: Same as the recommended option, plus the Name subset type (verified: 34 verified, 0 errors), co-shipping that line of BK-434 and tagging TREE-007/011 too. Conflicts with #1130 if it edits StoreTree.dfy, and overrides the § 10 assignment.

questions.question: `// @spec TREE-n` in a .dfy fails F1 (no conformance marker until BK-436), and _BASELINE must not grow. How should StoreTree.dfy §12 cite spec 051?

options.label: Prose cites, BK-436 converts (Recommended)
options.description: Keep spec 051 and TREE-007 named in §12's comments, with no @spec syntax. Add one clause to BK-436's entry: when conformance lands, §12's cites become @spec tags. No tooling change. The tie is a verified lemma, but no gate notices if §12 is deleted.

options.label: Extend the checker: .dfy restatements
options.description: Teach check_formal_trace.py's R source to read `// @restates` and `// @spec` in a .dfy file, kept out of D. R2 then demands all 12 TREE IDs in StoreTree.dfy, and TREE-007/011 can't be tagged honestly before BK-434. Needs a carve-out plus tests, so it is a much bigger PR.

options.label: Move §12 to a subdirectory file
options.description: Put the lemma in sdd/formal/<subdir>/, which D's top-level glob skips, so @spec tags there are inert. Needs wiring in dafny_verify.sh and CI's verify-formal. The tags look gated but aren't, which is misleading.
